helper:
-- Research: the actual landed value-line route already covers surviving marks.
  have h_chainD : (∃ ns : List Nat, RegisterWitness.MarkedColsIn s' (k :: ns) ∧ ∀ nv ∈ ns,
      ∀ sp_v : SurfPos, SBlockMapEntry k sp_ind sp_v →
      ∀ sp_i sp_c : SurfPos, SIndent nv sp_v sp_i → GLit ':' sp_i sp_c →
      ∀ sp_w : SurfPos, SBlockIndented nv .blockOut sp_c sp_w →
      ResumeFrames (SLYamlStream sp_start) [FrameLevel.map nv] sp_w) ∨ PackAlt sc := by
    rcases h_explUp_chainD with paid | declined
    · exact Or.inl paid
    · rcases h_resV_land with hall | _
      · refine Or.inl ⟨(RegisterWitness.markedCols s').filter (fun x => decide (x ≠ k)), ?_, ?_⟩
        · apply (RegisterWitness.MarkedColsIn.self s').mono
          intro x hx
          by_cases he : x = k
          · exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl he)
          · exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr (List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx, by simp [he]⟩))
        · intro nv hm
          obtain ⟨hm', hne⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp hm
          obtain ⟨_, _, contV⟩ := hall nv hm' (of_decide_eq_true hne)
          exact resumeFrameRouteK h_ind contV
      · exact Or.inr declined
